description: Reload the active window (or windowId, which also selects it) and wait, within readyTimeoutMs (default 5000), for the new page to render, like electron_launch; then optionally for waitForSelector to be visible. Use it instead of location.reload() in eval. ignoreCache does a hard reload. Refs from before the reload are gone. Returns: { ok, session_id, renderer_ready, url }. Errors: WAIT_TIMEOUT (waitForSelector not visible in time; retryable), REF_NOT_FOUND (no such window), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid selector).

readyTimeoutMs.description: Budget in ms for the new page and waitForSelector. Default 5000.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

waitForSelector.description: Once the page is ready, wait for this selector to be visible.

windowId.description: Window to reload and select. Default: active.

name: electron_reload
title: Reload a window
